explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/978: Heath-Brown (k ≥ 10) and Browning [Br11] (k ≥ 9) showed that an irreducible f with no fixed (k-2)-th power prime divisor takes infinitely many (k-2)-power-free values (indeed with an asymptotic). The statement matches, with degree ≥ 9, irreducibility and the fixed-divisor hypothesis. The sign of the leading coefficient is irrelevant because Powerfree is invariant under associates. Faithful.
